name: presence_bucket_changed
description: Fires when the presence bucket transitions (active / idle / away_short / away_long / locked).

name: user_returned
description: Fires when the user returns to active from idle / away / locked.

name: user_became_idle
description: Fires when active transitions to idle. Useful for suppressing interruptions.

name: first_activity_today
description: Fires once per local calendar day on the first detection of activity. Persisted across restarts. No payload.

name: long_session_warning
description: Notifies that continuous active time has exceeded 90 minutes. Useful as a break-suggestion trigger.

name: session_locked
description: Fires when the OS session is locked. No payload.

name: session_unlocked
description: Fires when the OS session is unlocked. No payload.

name: session_logon
description: Fires when an OS session starts. No payload.

name: session_logoff
description: Fires when an OS session ends. No payload.

name: foreground_changed
description: Fires when the foreground app's process_name or category differs from the last emit. The category_changed flag distinguishes a category transition (replaces the old foreground_app_category_changed event).

payloadKeys.description: New app's category (empty string when no data).
New app's display name (empty string when no data).
"true" / "false" relative to the last emit's category. "false" when the app changed but stayed within the same category.

name: foreground_title_changed
description: Fires when the foreground window title (raw or summary) changes. Tab/file switches within the same app are recorded here. raw_window_title and titleSummary.* require separate opt-in paths.

payloadKeys.description: Current work category (empty string when no data).
Current app display name (empty string when no data).
Raw window title. Page names, file names, DM partners, search queries, etc.

name: battery_medium
description: Fires when battery level enters the medium bucket (20–50%).

name: battery_low
description: Fires when battery level enters the low bucket (10–20%).

name: battery_critical
description: Fires when battery level enters the critical bucket (<10%).

name: battery_percent_crossed_threshold
description: Fires when battery percent crosses one of the 80 / 50 / 30 / 20 thresholds.

name: charger_connected
description: Fires when the charger is connected. No payload.

name: charger_disconnected
description: Fires when the charger is disconnected. No payload.

name: power_source_changed
description: Fires on AC / battery / short_term power source transitions.

payloadKeys.description: Previous power source ("unknown" on first observation).

name: ac_power_connected
description: Fires when AC power becomes the source, paired with power_source_changed.

payloadKeys.description: Previous power source ("unknown" on first observation).

name: battery_power_active
description: Fires when battery becomes the active power source.

payloadKeys.description: Previous power source ("unknown" on first observation).

name: short_term_power_active
description: Fires when a short-term power source (e.g. UPS) becomes active.

payloadKeys.description: Previous power source ("unknown" on first observation).

name: power_setting_changed
description: Notification of an OS power setting change (AC/DC source, monitor power, lid switch, etc).

payloadKeys.description: Setting identifier (Windows: GUID / macOS: setting name).

name: system_suspend
description: Fires when the system begins suspending. No payload.

name: system_resume_user
description: Fires on user-initiated resume from sleep. No payload.

name: system_resume_automatic
description: Fires on automatic resume from sleep (timer, Wake-on-LAN, etc). No payload.

name: system_under_load
description: Fires when CPU or memory pressure reaches high or above.

name: context_switch_burst
description: Fires when app-switch frequency spikes within a short window. Hints at work rhythm.

payloadKeys.description: Number of switches in the last minute.

name: media_session_changed
description: Fires when OS media session details change (Windows: SMTC / macOS: Music, Spotify). title / artist are classified high under separate paths and require both user opt-in and context.high:read scope.

payloadKeys.description: AppUserModelId of the source app (e.g. Spotify, a Chrome tab).
Coarse media kind inferred from source_app: "music" / "video" / "browser" / "unknown". Browser is its own category since tab contents can't be inspected. Heuristic — misclassification is possible.
Track / video title. Reveals listening / viewing history.

name: media_playback_started
description: Fires when media transitions to Playing.

name: media_playback_paused
description: Fires when media transitions to Paused.

name: media_playback_stopped
description: Fires when media transitions to Stopped.

name: media_playback_status_changed
description: Generic event when PlaybackStatus moves to a value other than Playing / Paused / Stopped (e.g. Buffering).

name: network_connectivity_changed
description: Fires on network online / offline transition.

name: timezone_changed
description: Fires when the time zone ID changes. Suggests travel or a settings change.

name: display_count_changed
description: Fires when the number of displays changes (external monitor connect / disconnect).
